interpretation_limits: The 32 seeds are outcome-selected from already-spent Worker #23 data.
Cohort proportions do not generalize to the 100-seed development set or any population.
This slice diagnoses mechanism only; it does not evaluate or support a new policy.
No hidden draw identity or future outcome is used as a diagnostic mechanism feature.

feature_contributions.note: Counts are tie-inclusive diagnostic associations, not single-feature causal ablations.

water_compactness_interpretation: At first tier divergence, tied V6-preferred best-second options have zero weighted delta_visible_water, delta_water_obstruction, new_trapped_water, places_exit_ready, places_exit_early, and wins contributions in the all-32 aggregate.
The positive second-step terms most frequently associated with expansion are collect_needed and bounded_merge_setup_gain; delta_open_tunnels is mixed and net negative across tied best-second options.
The strong endpoint water/compactness differences therefore emerge downstream after the initial lookahead-induced tier expansion rather than from a direct first-divergence water reward.
